feeds.title: The Thrifty Issue Blog
feeds.description: The Thrifty Issue, a beacon for Aussie mums, champions financial independence and control. Through savvy money management and resourceful tips, it empowers women to navigate life's financial terrain confidently. With a diverse team of Aussie mum writers, it offers a treasure trove of insights, experiences, recipes, and side gigs, fostering a community dedicated to making and saving more.

feeds.title: Strong Money Australia Blog
feeds.description: Dave, the force behind Strong Money Australia, dedicates his platform to guiding individuals towards Financial Independence and Early Retirement (FIRE) in Australia. Through insightful articles and podcasts, he shares invaluable lessons and thoughts gleaned from his journey. Dive into Dave's wealth of knowledge to master the path to financial independence and early retirement down under.

feeds.title: Captain FI » Making Money
feeds.description: Captain FI, the retired international Air Transport Pilot from Australia, is a fervent advocate for Financial Literacy. Through writing and podcasting, he shares insights on financial education, aviation, and his journey to achieving Financial Independence and early retirement at 30. Embark on Captain FI's enriching journey towards financial freedom and early retirement.

feeds.title: Scotty Pass » Make Money Online
feeds.description: Scotty, a multifaceted travel content creator, writer, vlogger, and affiliate marketer, established his blog to empower others to earn online and live life on their terms. Through insightful content, he guides individuals in monetizing their brand via content creation, blogging, and affiliate marketing tools aligned with their values. Join Scotty's journey to unlock the potential of online earning and meaningful travel experiences.
